g.text: dB relative to each panel peak

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Cyan circles: desired sources. White +: top local maxima. Every panel uses −12…0 dB relative to its own peak, with absolute peak-power labels.
Fixed held-out examples: noise seed 4007, pulse peak amplitude 0.04; source-pair seed 5007. Same underlying acoustic scenes for all candidates.
The bright peak alone is not evidence of detection: noise-only thresholds and localization accuracy determine the aggregate scores.
